_comment: M28.4.3 set_uds_member_default soak-only. Marked skip_inspect: true to match M28.4.1/M28.4.2 scope. The soak gate validates byte-identity of the mutated scratch .uasset across 2 rounds — round 1 changes BpxRemovalCandidate's default value from '7' (fixture-seeded) to '99' via ChangeVariableDefaultValue, round 2 sees the DefaultValue string already '99' and short-circuits via the bridge's before==value string compare (skipped="value already match"). Exercises the dedicated C++ UFUNCTION SetUserDefinedStructMemberDefault that wraps FStructureEditorUtils::ChangeVariableDefaultValue rather than rerouting through the generic SetPropertyValue bridge — the dedicated path writes VarDesc.DefaultValue (authoritative string) and triggers OnStructureChanged(DefaultValueChanged) -> RecreateDefaultInstanceInEditorData so the serialized string + DefaultInstance memory stay in sync (M28.4.0 research Open Question #1 resolution). A direct SetPropertyValue write would have left the UDS in a torn state.
